paragraphs: Chapter 882
Episode 220. Untiring (4)
In the Infernal Realm, Poison King Castle.
Vice Skarlo, Kukan Ten, Sikerer Highta, Misol Hyuan, Tillyas Bisechs, Dailrus Claufino, Leila Belgasium.
The seven Demon Kings visited Ragal's Poison King Castle.
The Poison King Castle was the Poison King Castle until a few days ago, but as soon as Ragal received the title of 'Demon' from Zito, he first changed the name of the castle.
"Ha ha ha, having you all here really makes me feel like I've become a king. I'm a bit disappointed that some friends couldn't or didn't come."
Ragal smirked at the kings seated in the banquet hall.
"You've stayed as a Warlord for too long, given your ability."
"Ah, Kukan, thank you for saying that. Hehe!"
"Moreover, you've received the title of 'The Honorable' from Lord Zito, the same status as Paelito. I'm going mad with jealousy."
"So, didn't I almost kill Elona Zipli, one of the strongest among the tributaries, to live up to that name, Sikerer?"
"Misol, Misol."
"Ah, Misol, you still can't speak. It's fine as long as you understand this much, right?"
"Misol."
"……Congratulations, Lord Ragal."
"Poor Tillyas Bisechs! You're a king just like us, so don't be too cautious. The one eyeing the back of Lord Zito's head is that damned Basset, not you, right?"

Tillyas Bisechs was the only Demon King from 'Bisechs', a faction that is currently the only one resisting Zito in the Infernal Realm. Despite being recognized by Zito for his loyalty and abilities and becoming a Demon King, most of the demon races didn't look at him favorably.
"Thank you for your consideration."

"You should be more thankful to Dailrus sitting next to you. Dailrus is watching over that madman every day. Hey, Dailrus. Have you restored all the castles that were battered by Basset's surprise attack last time?"
"That's none of your concern."
Ragal smirked at Dailrus's stiff attitude.
"Really? I was just worried and asked, but you're grumpy. If you're jealous that I became the Poison King, just say you're jealous. Be honest like Sikerer."
Dailrus turned his head as if it wasn't worth responding. Still, Ragal was happy to have become the Poison King.
"Ragal Fun. What is this?"
But no matter how happy he was, he couldn't overlook Leila's high-handed tone. After all, she was the younger sister of Paelito, whom Ragal used to envy and covet.
"Ah, I didn't invite her. Why? What's the problem?"
"The spirits in this banquet hall. Haven't you heard the order of the Sword Demon? He clearly said to stop producing spirits for a while."

"Bullshit, those kind of restrictions are only for the lower ones to follow faithfully. Do you think it makes sense that we, the demon kings, can't even drink as we please because of his word? Leila."
"Those who have been kings since a thousand years ago are also following the Sword Demon's orders... ever since you became king and gained the title of demon, you are becoming more and more mad."
"Let's hear it."
Shh!
Leila's sword was instantly at Ragal's throat.

"If you disobey the order once more, and insult the Sword Demon, there won't be a moment when my sword will stop like it is now. Ragal Pun, know your place. You should know well that I don't have a merciful personality like the Sword Demon."
"Ah, why are you all like this! On such a good occasion."
"Right, don't be too harsh on Ragal just because he made a small mistake, Leila. We came to celebrate, and he only poured a little spirit, isn't that right, Ragal?"
"Misol, misol, misol."
As Bice, Kukan, Shiker, and Misol stepped in, Ragal relaxed his expression and shrugged his shoulders. Then Ragal clapped his hands and servants busily brought food into the banquet hall.
Dailerus and Leila.
The meal proceeded in a warm atmosphere, except for those two. However, the other demon kings kept an eye on those two, excluding Ragal.
By the end of the meal, one of Ragal's subordinates rushed to find the banquet hall. He was holding a crystal ball containing a video sent by Sakiel.
"Lord Ragal, I just received a video from the Central Library."
"Video? What is it?"
"They say it's the battle of Demon King Zicarlo."
"Zicarlo? He should have gone to receive the ground garrison, did the humans attack Zicarlo first?"
"That seems to be the case. The atmosphere in the Central Library doesn't seem good."
"Okay, leave the crystal ball and go."
"The atmosphere isn't good, did Zicarlo lose to someone?"
"Unlikely, that Zicarlo. Even if he lost, he must have survived."
Ragal played the video.
As expected, the video showed Zicarlo being brutally beaten by Luna. The demon kings couldn't take their eyes off the video without saying a word.
"If there's nothing else, it's time to end this. But don't be too discouraged to die by my hand. You were strong enough, Zicarlo."
As soon as that statement ended, most of the demon kings unknowingly opened their mouths to the endless red sword energy that dyed the sky.
Even after finishing off Zicarlo, Luna showed no signs of fatigue.

"What... what is this? Hey, Leila. Didn't Paelrito say that there are restrictions to the red energy of the Hundred Scenes? That human, she used that much red power and doesn't seem to have any problems."
"Mi, Misol...."
"That she destroyed Zikalo so easily....? She's neither Shiron Lun Kendall nor Elona Zif, right? I heard Luna Lun Kendall was definitely weaker than them."
While not quite to Luna's extent, the subsequent battles of Sirius and the generals were shocking enough.
"That's Manbing... Could Manbing also have a power like that red energy, capable of obliterating General-level demons?"
"Damn it, Sykan...! That bastard dared to touch my kin!"
Cucan exploded with anger as he watched Sirius wipe out the generals. Sykan, who died along with Billagul, was one of the core powers of Tenga.
"Having lost both Zikalo and Billagul, the salt territories and Lamierga are finished..."
When the video ended, Laila looked at the demon kings.
She and Dailus had already checked the video before coming to the poison castle.
"This is exactly what the Demon Kings and the Generals should be doing."
"Laila?"
"What are you talking about?"
"Before Zito takes on the position as Insa... or before Insa breaks into the demon world. The Demon Kings and Generals must exhaust all the red energy that Luna Lun Kendall has."
The eyes of the demon kings widened.
"Get rid of that?"
"Is it an order from Paelrito?"
"No, Paelrito is too much. Zikalo ended up like that, how are we supposed to do that? Isn't it right for Paelrito himself to step forward?"
"I wonder if you could have said that even if Geomma was here, Bice."
"Ugh, well."
"Besides, this is not Paelrito's command, but Zito's."
Laila cut through the air with her hand. A tiny space opened in the air, and Laila pulled out the black masses inside.

"You know, this is Zito's flesh. I'll distribute one by one, use it when dealing with Luna Lun Kendall. Of course, even if you have Zito's flesh, you must absolutely avoid one-on-one. At least two or three must act together."
"Oh, right. There's no need to fight like a gentleman. Since Zikalo fought one-on-one, I naturally got confused. If several demon kings possessing Zito's flesh fight at once, it could work."
"But they also have the ability to leap through space. Support could come at any time."
"That's why Zito keeps creating rifts to prevent humans from doing so. Fortunately, among our abilities, there are types that can control space leaps."
"Misol, Misol."
While the demon kings were conversing, Ragal quietly mused.
'...What? Just a while ago, Zito warned Paelrito directly at the sword demon castle because he used one piece of flesh. But now suddenly he is distributing flesh to the demon kings?'
"Of course, at the time, Jito did add that 'a loss for fun' was fine, but Ragal remembered Jito's annoyed moments on the way back.

'I can't figure out Jito's intentions. Jito seemed sensitive about losing flesh due to Aryula. Or maybe, are they the pieces of flesh that Paelrito had kept when he opposed Jito in the past? So, he might be planning to use the Demon Kings as a shield behind Jito’s back and snatch the merit.’
Either way, it's not certain. Ragal concluded that he should not provoke Raila further for now and check with Jito later.
"If it's an order from Lord Jito, of course we must follow. Haha, Raila. It seems you've already had a private talk with Lord Jito. So who among us should go first to face the enemy?"
"Not you, Ragal."
"I suppose. I've just beaten Elona Zipul, so I need some rest. Sometimes our Lord Jito can be so considerate."
"I'll go first! I need to avenge Sikan."
"If possible, I would also like to go, Lady Raila."
It was Tillyas. Of course, he was a person who needed to keep earning merit to gain trust from the other demons. Raila nodded.
"Kukan Ten, Vice Skarlo, Tillyas Bisebs, Misol Hwan. You four go at once. The Sword Demon will open the way for you to go out within a few days."
"Wow, if the four of us go out at once, each with a piece of Lord Jito’s flesh, we might be able to kill Luna Runkandel, not just exhaust the red energy."

"If that happens, the four of you may also receive a new title from Lord Jito, just like Ragal. But don't let your guard down because there are four of you. None of you is stronger than Jikalo without a piece of flesh. Oh, Misol might be similar at best."
"MisolSol."

At the evaluation that they are weaker than Jikalo, the Demon Kings couldn't show their displeasure. The hierarchy among the Demon Kings is the same, but it's a fact that there's a big gap in actual strength. Especially, it was doubtful whether all the Demon Kings gathered here could win against Raila.
"But why aren't you going, Raila? I understand that Dailrus is busy because of Basset, but isn't it better for you to go alone than to send these four?"
"Currently, the Sword Demon can't make a way for me to go. I also have other things to do."
"Is that also an order from Lord Jito?"
"Yes."
"Can't you tell us what it is?"
Ignoring Ragal, Raila stood up from her seat.
"I'll go back now. Remember, the Demon Kings and the generals must definitely eradicate Luna Runkandel's red power."
The banquet ended two hours after Raila left.
When all the Demon Kings had left, Ragal called his lieutenant.
"Gero, you said those were in the soul prison?"
"Yes, Lord Ragal. We sneaked them into our toxic area this morning and hid them well. Would you like to meet them right away?"
"Yes, I need to adjust them once before use. Tsk tsk, foolish Raila. She must not know that I’m not cultivating soul lords for nothing?"
